# UAVmatrix Docs

> Documentation for UAVcast-Pro (software on a drone's companion computer that streams MAVLink telemetry and H.264 video to ground stations over 4G/LTE, Wi-Fi or a VPN) and UAVmatrix Fleet Manager (the web dashboard for managing drones, ground stations and teams).

Every page below is also available as HTML without the .md suffix. Translations exist under /es/, /it/, /nl/, /pl/, /pt/, /ru/, /tr/, /zh-cn/ and /zh-tw/ with the same paths. The full English documentation in one file: https://docs.uavmatrix.com/llms-full.txt

## Get started

- [What is UAVcast-Pro?](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/overview.md): UAVcast-Pro turns a Raspberry Pi or Linux companion computer into a 4G/LTE link for MAVLink telemetry and H.264 video. See how it works with Fleet Manager.
- [Quick start](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/quick-start.md): Connect a MAVLink flight controller to UAVcast-Pro and get telemetry and live video in Mission Planner or QGroundControl, first on your LAN, then over 4G/LTE.
- [Hardware requirements](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/hardware-requirements.md): Which Raspberry Pi or Linux computer, flight controller, camera and 4G/LTE modem work with UAVcast-Pro, plus wiring, power and storage requirements.
- [Install UAVcast-Pro](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/installation.md): Install UAVcast-Pro with one command on a 64-bit Raspberry Pi OS, Debian or Ubuntu system (arm64 or amd64), then open the web interface and create an admin user.
- [Licensing & activation](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/license-activation.md): How to buy a UAVcast-Pro license, activate it on a drone, check device slots, renew it, and move it to a new Raspberry Pi or SD card by unregistering the old device.
- [Update UAVcast-Pro](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/get-started/updating.md): Update UAVcast-Pro from the web interface or the command line, install an older version, and what happens to your settings, server port and recordings.

## UAVcast-Pro

- [UAVcast-Pro](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro.md): Reference for the UAVcast-Pro web interface: dashboard, flight controller, flight map, ground stations, camera, modem, VPN, Fleet Manager pairing, users and settings.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/dashboard.md): Read the UAVcast-Pro dashboard to check the flight controller, GPS, battery, ground station link, cellular, VPN, RTK, video and Raspberry Pi power, temperature and throttling.
- [Data Streams](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/data-streams.md): Create UAVcast-Pro Data Streams dashboards with charts, gauges and tiles for any MAVLink field or NAMED_VALUE_FLOAT sensor value, with thresholds, history and JSON import/export.
- [Connect the flight controller](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-controller.md): Connect a Pixhawk or any other ArduPilot or PX4 flight controller to UAVcast-Pro over USB or UART, with automatic port and baud detection and a live connection check.
- [NTRIP / RTK corrections](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-controller/ntrip-rtk.md): Stream RTCM3 corrections from an NTRIP caster over 4G/LTE to your flight controller for RTK Fixed positioning. Caster, mountpoint, VRS and GGA settings.
- [Injectors](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-controller/injectors.md): Use UAVcast-Pro injectors to push sensor readings from scripts, Arduinos or the LTE modem into the MAVLink stream over HTTP, UDP or serial, so QGC and Mission Planner see them.
- [Flight Map](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-map.md): Track your drone live on the UAVcast-Pro Flight Map with a cockpit HUD, video windows, arm/disarm, flight modes, RTL, loiter, GCS failsafe and flight controller messages.
- [Mission Planner tab](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-map/mission-planner.md): Plan a waypoint mission in the UAVcast-Pro Mission Planner tab, set altitude frame and radius, save it as a .waypoints file and upload it to the ArduPilot flight controller.
- [Radio tab](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-map/radio.md): See live RC channel PWM values and RSSI from your flight controller in the UAVcast-Pro Radio tab, to check transmitter switches and RC camera switching.
- [MAVLink Inspector](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-map/inspector.md): Use the UAVcast-Pro MAVLink Inspector to see every message from the flight controller with its rate, system ID and component ID, and debug telemetry and injectors.
- [Flight Analytics](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/flight-map/flight-analytics.md): Graph live MAVLink telemetry or a recorded .tlog file in UAVcast-Pro Flight Analytics. Pick up to 10 parameters, compare them over time and review a flight on the drone.
- [Ground control stations](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations.md): Add ground station destinations in UAVcast-Pro to stream MAVLink telemetry (UDP 14550) and H.264 video (UDP 5600) to Mission Planner, QGroundControl or several PCs.
- [Mission Planner](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/mission-planner.md): Connect Mission Planner to a UAVcast-Pro drone: MAVLink over UDP 14550, live H.264 video in the HUD with the exact GStreamer source, Windows firewall, a second camera and common errors.
- [QGroundControl](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/qgroundcontrol.md): Get UAVcast-Pro telemetry and live H.264 video into QGroundControl on Windows, macOS or Linux: UDP 14550 auto-connect, Video Source UDP h.264 on port 5600, low latency mode and fixes.
- [GStreamer on Windows](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/gstreamer-windows.md): Install GStreamer on Windows (MSVC 64-bit, Complete), add it to PATH and play UAVcast-Pro H.264 video and Opus audio with gst-launch-1.0 in PowerShell or cmd. Firewall and fixes.
- [GStreamer on Linux](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/gstreamer-linux.md): Install GStreamer on Ubuntu, Debian or Fedora and play UAVcast-Pro H.264 drone video and Opus audio with gst-launch-1.0, including a second camera, low latency and ufw.
- [GStreamer on macOS](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/gstreamer-macos.md): Install GStreamer on a Mac with Homebrew or the official package and play UAVcast-Pro H.264 drone video and Opus audio with gst-launch-1.0, plus the macOS firewall prompt.
- [Android and tablets](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/android.md): Receive UAVcast-Pro telemetry and live video on an Android phone or tablet with QGroundControl, over Wi-Fi or 4G through a VPN, plus the browser option for iPad.
- [VLC and RTSP](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/ground-stations/vlc-and-rtsp.md): Play UAVcast-Pro H.264 RTP video in VLC with an SDP file, or pull the camera from the drone over RTSP on port 8554 for a recording PC, video wall or third-party software.
- [Cellular modem (4G/LTE)](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/connectivity/cellular-modem.md): Connect a HiLink or traditional 4G/LTE USB modem to UAVcast-Pro, with automatic APN detection, SIM PIN, auto-reconnect and modem signal information for flying over cellular.
- [VPN](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/connectivity/vpn.md): Put your drone and ground station on one private network with the Fleet Manager VPN, or your own Tailscale or ZeroTier network, so telemetry and video work over 4G/LTE.
- [Dynamic DNS](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/connectivity/dynamic-dns.md): Keep a hostname pointed at your drone's changing public IP with UAVcast-Pro Dynamic DNS (No-IP, DynDNS, DuckDNS or a generic URL), and when a VPN is the better choice.
- [Networks](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/connectivity/networks.md): See every network interface on the drone and choose whether Wi-Fi or the 4G/LTE modem carries the traffic, so the link stays on cellular when you fly out of Wi-Fi range.
- [Camera settings](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/camera.md): Set up a Raspberry Pi camera or USB webcam in UAVcast-Pro and stream low-latency H.264 video over UDP to QGroundControl or Mission Planner. Resolution, FPS and bitrate.
- [Two cameras: RC switching and dual stream](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/camera/multi-camera.md): Connect two cameras to UAVcast-Pro and switch between them from your RC transmitter, or stream both at once to QGroundControl or Mission Planner on separate UDP ports.
- [Audio](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/camera/audio.md): Add sound from a USB microphone or a webcam's built-in mic to the UAVcast-Pro live preview, and send it to ground stations as an RTP/Opus stream on Video Port + 2.
- [Custom GStreamer pipeline](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/camera/custom-pipeline.md): Use a custom GStreamer pipeline in UAVcast-Pro to stream an RTSP IP camera, a thermal camera, H.265 or a test pattern, with examples and how preview and destinations behave.
- [Recordings and flight review](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/camera/recordings.md): Record camera video and MAVLink telemetry on the drone with UAVcast-Pro, automatically when armed, to the SD card or a USB SSD, and review flights with video, map and data.
- [Pair with Fleet Manager](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/fleet-pairing.md): Connect a drone running UAVcast-Pro to UAVmatrix Fleet Manager: get the pairing code on the drone, enter it in Fleet Manager, check the connection, rename or unpair.
- [Users & access](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/users.md): Secure the UAVcast-Pro web interface with an admin login, add read-only users who can watch telemetry and video but not control the drone, and change or reset passwords.
- [Application settings, logs and backups](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/uavcast-pro/application-settings.md): Change the UAVcast-Pro web port and language, download logs for support with debug mode, and back up, restore or reset the settings database from the Application page.

## Fleet Manager

- [Fleet Manager](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager.md): UAVmatrix Fleet Manager tracks every UAVcast-Pro drone on one live map, with remote control, missions, VPN streaming to ground stations and team roles.
- [Set up your organization](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/set-up-organization.md): Sign in to Fleet Manager with your UAVmatrix account, create the organization your drones and team belong to, and switch, rename or delete it.
- [Add your first drone](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/pair-uav.md): Pair a UAVcast-Pro drone with your Fleet Manager organization using the 8-digit pairing code, choose VPN access and see it live on the fleet map.
- [Connect a ground station](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/connect-gcs.md): Join a QGroundControl or Mission Planner laptop to your organization's VPN with one Tailscale command and start receiving drone video and telemetry.
- [Invite your team](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/team.md): Invite pilots, operators and customers to your Fleet Manager organization by email, change roles, revoke invitations and transfer ownership.
- [Roles and permissions](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/team/roles-and-permissions.md): The exact permission matrix for Fleet Manager's Owner, Admin and Viewer roles: pairing, flight commands, terminal, missions, VPN and team.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/dashboard.md): Read the Fleet Manager dashboard at a glance - total and online UAVs, team size, the UAV status list, the Getting Started checklist and the recent activity log.
- [Fleet](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/fleet.md): The Fleet page lists every UAV in your organization with live status, battery and last check-in, and is where you pair drones and open controls.
- [UAV details](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/fleet/uav-details.md): A drone's page in Fleet Manager shows live telemetry and companion computer health, an SSH terminal and MAVLink log, and reboot or remove.
- [Remote control](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/fleet/remote-control.md): Change flight modes, arm or disarm, run missions and start a preflight calibration from Fleet Manager's UAV control panel, with safety checks.
- [Open UAVcast-Pro remotely](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/fleet/remote-uavcast.md): Reach a drone's UAVcast-Pro settings from anywhere through Fleet Manager, either via the built-in proxy without VPN or directly over your organization's VPN.
- [Re-pair, remove or transfer a drone](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/fleet/remove-or-transfer.md): Re-pair a drone when Fleet Manager asks, remove it from your organization, move it to another one or replace its companion computer.
- [Live map](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/map.md): Track every drone in your fleet on one live map with status rings, heading lines, 5-minute trails, follow mode and OpenAIP airspace layers.
- [Flight history](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/map/flight-history.md): Replay a drone's recorded flight on the Fleet Manager map, read duration, max altitude and speed, save named flights and set telemetry retention.
- [Missions](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/missions.md): Draw waypoint missions on the map, choose MAVLink commands and altitude frames, save missions for the whole organization and upload them to any online drone.
- [Network and VPN](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/network.md): Enable your organization's private WireGuard VPN in Fleet Manager, connect drones and ground station laptops, and manage the devices table.
- [Stream bindings](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/network/stream-bindings.md): Route video and MAVLink from any drone to any ground station over VPN, how Fleet Manager assigns UDP ports, and QGC and Mission Planner setup.
- [Status indicators and notifications](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/alerts-and-status.md): What Fleet Manager's offline, no-MAVLink, GPS, failsafe and battery indicators mean, plus system announcements, the status page and alerts.
- [Licenses and seats](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/licenses.md): How UAVcast-Pro licenses and device slots decide which drones you can pair in Fleet Manager, and how to use licenses bought with another email.
- [Lite view](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/lite-view.md): Lite view is Fleet Manager's phone-sized control screen: fleet list, live battery, GPS and altitude, flight modes and mission start, pause and RTL.
- [Settings, account and billing](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/settings.md): The Fleet Manager Settings tabs for profile, organizations, support and history, where billing and invoices live, and how to delete your account.
- [Support and FleetBot](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/support.md): Get help inside Fleet Manager: ask the FleetBot assistant, open a support ticket with a screenshot, follow its status and check system status.
- [Security and privacy](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/security.md): How Fleet Manager secures drones with per-drone TLS certificates, isolates organizations on private WireGuard VPNs, enforces roles and stores data.
- [Fleet Manager troubleshooting](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/troubleshooting.md): Fix common Fleet Manager problems: pairing errors, drones stuck on PAIRING or offline, re-pair required, missing streams and failed commands.
- [Fleet Manager FAQ](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/fleet-manager/faq.md): Answers to common Fleet Manager questions: drone limits, licenses, VPN, ground stations, ArduPilot and PX4, data retention and moving drones.

## Guides

- [Guides](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides.md): Step-by-step guides for UAVcast-Pro: fly over 4G, VPN remote access, multiple ground stations, RTK over NTRIP, two cameras and fleet onboarding.
- [Fly beyond visual range over 4G](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/bvlos-4g.md): Fly a drone over 4G/LTE with UAVcast-Pro, a cellular modem and the Fleet Manager VPN, with telemetry and live video in QGroundControl or Mission Planner.
- [Remote access with Tailscale](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/remote-access-tailscale.md): Reach your drone over LTE with Tailscale and UAVcast-Pro, no port forwarding: log in by URL or auth key, add the laptop as a GCS, stop key expiry.
- [Stream to multiple ground stations](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/multiple-ground-stations.md): Send telemetry and live video from one drone to several QGroundControl or Mission Planner stations with UAVcast-Pro, with read-only observers.
- [RTK GPS over 4G with an NTRIP caster](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/rtk-ntrip-caster.md): Stream RTCM3 corrections from an NTRIP caster over LTE to your flight controller with UAVcast-Pro for RTK Fixed, with no base station on site.
- [Two cameras: RC switching or dual stream](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/dual-camera-rc-switching.md): Connect two cameras to UAVcast-Pro and switch between them from your RC transmitter, or stream both at once with dual stream. Setup, ports and CPU.
- [Record flights and review them](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/recording-flight-review.md): Record camera video and telemetry on the drone automatically when armed, store it on USB or SSD, and replay video, map and flight data on one timeline.
- [Onboard a fleet of drones with Fleet Manager](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/guides/fleet-onboarding.md): Plan licenses, then name, pair and connect 20+ UAVcast-Pro drones to UAVmatrix Fleet Manager, with team roles, the organization VPN and stream bindings.

## Troubleshooting & FAQ

- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting.md): Fix no video, no MAVLink heartbeat, modem and VPN problems, license errors and Fleet Manager pairing. Start from what you see and follow the checks.
- [No video in QGroundControl or Mission Planner](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/no-video-in-gcs.md): Telemetry works but video stays black in QGroundControl or Mission Planner? Check the camera, Enable Video, the destination IP, UDP 5600 and the GCS.
- [Choppy, laggy or grey video over 4G](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/choppy-or-delayed-video.md): Fix stuttering, grey smears and lag in UAVcast-Pro video over LTE or VPN by matching bitrate, resolution, FPS and Stream Recovery Rate to the link.
- [No MAVLink heartbeat from the flight controller](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/no-mavlink-heartbeat.md): UAVcast-Pro shows No heartbeat or Waiting for device? Check the USB cable, TELEM wiring, SERIAL protocol and baud rate, then use Auto-detect.
- [No telemetry in QGroundControl or Mission Planner](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/no-telemetry-in-gcs.md): Flight controller connected in UAVcast-Pro but QGroundControl or Mission Planner keeps waiting? Check Enable Telemetry, the IP, UDP 14550 and VPN.
- [Camera not detected](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/camera-not-detected.md): UAVcast-Pro shows No cameras available? Check the CSI ribbon cable, rpicam-hello, camera support on Ubuntu and v4l2-ctl for USB cameras.
- [UAVcast-Pro license won't activate](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/license-activation-failed.md): Fix Invalid license key, Maximum activations reached and License activation failed in UAVcast-Pro: the key, internet, free slots and replaced hardware.
- [4G modem connected but no internet](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/modem-no-internet.md): LTE modem shows signal and an operator but the drone has no internet? Check modem type, APN, SIM PIN and data, network priority and the default route.
- [Web interface won't open](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/web-interface-wont-open.md): Can't open UAVcast-Pro at http://device-ip after installing? Find the right address, check the uavcast-web service, the server port and port 80.
- [Installation fails](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/installation-fails.md): Fix UAVcast-Pro installer errors like No installation candidate found or failed dependencies: check the 64-bit OS, internet, disk and installer log.
- [VPN connected but can't reach the drone](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/vpn-cant-reach-drone.md): Fleet Manager VPN, Tailscale or ZeroTier says connected but you can't ping the drone? Check authorization, the network or tailnet, internet and the GCS IP.
- [RTK corrections not arriving](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/rtk-corrections-not-arriving.md): NTRIP stuck on Connecting, no RTCM forwarded or no RTK Fixed? Check caster host, port, mountpoint, credentials, GGA upstream and the GPS receiver.
- [Undervoltage and throttling](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/undervoltage-and-throttling.md): UAVcast-Pro warns Voltage too low or Slowed down? Size the power supply for Pi, modem and camera, fix thin cables and cooling, and stop resets.
- [Drone shows Offline in Fleet Manager](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/drone-offline-fleet-manager.md): Paired UAV shows Offline or Re-pair required in Fleet Manager? Check the drone's internet, outbound port 8883, UAVcast-Pro Fleet Management and the license.
- [Pairing code invalid or expired](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/pairing-code-invalid.md): Fix Invalid pairing code, This pairing code has expired and License is not owned by any member of this organization when pairing a UAV with Fleet Manager.
- [Collect logs for support](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/collect-logs.md): Download the UAVcast-Pro log archive with diagnostics.txt from Application, Logging, or over SSH, and send it to UAVmatrix support with the right details.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/troubleshooting/faq.md): Short answers about UAVcast-Pro hardware, LTE modems, ground stations, ports, offline use, licensing, updates, recording and Fleet Manager pairing.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference.md): Look-up pages for UAVcast-Pro and Fleet Manager: every setting with its default, ports and protocols, supported hardware, services, glossary, changelog.
- [Ports and protocols](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/ports-and-protocols.md): Every port UAVcast-Pro and Fleet Manager use: MAVLink UDP 14550, video UDP 5600, camera 2 and audio, web, preview, RTSP, NTRIP and MQTT 8883.
- [Settings reference](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/settings.md): Every UAVcast-Pro setting on one page with its exact label, default and range: flight controller, NTRIP, ground stations, camera, recording, modem, VPN.
- [Supported hardware](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/supported-hardware.md): Boards, operating systems, flight controllers, cameras, LTE modems and RTK receivers that work with UAVcast-Pro v6: Raspberry Pi, Jetson and other arm64 boards, and x86 PCs.
- [Services, files and installer options](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/services-and-files.md): The systemd services UAVcast-Pro installs, where it keeps its database, logs and recordings, installer options for versions, and handy SSH commands.
- [Glossary](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/glossary.md): Plain explanations of terms in the UAVcast-Pro and Fleet Manager docs: MAVLink, GCS, heartbeat, APN, HiLink, NTRIP, RTCM, VRS, ZeroTier, Tailscale.
- [Changelog](https://docs.uavmatrix.com/reference/changelog.md): What changed in each UAVcast-Pro v6 release, from the Rust rewrite in v6.0.0 to recording, flight review, audio, RTK over NTRIP and Fleet Manager.
